WITH japanese_sets AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_japanese
    FROM set_translations st
    WHERE st.language = 'Japanese'
),
expansion_sets AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_expansions
    FROM sets s
    WHERE s.type = 'expansion'
),
japanese_expansion_sets AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS japanese_expansions
    FROM set_translations st
    JOIN sets s ON st.setcode = s.code
    WHERE st.language = 'Japanese'
      AND s.type = 'expansion'
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN (SELECT total_japanese FROM japanese_sets) = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE ROUND((SELECT japanese_expansions FROM japanese_expansion_sets)::FLOAT * 100 /
                  (SELECT total_japanese FROM japanese_sets), 2)
    END AS percentage_japanese_expansion_sets;
